input.comment: [Playbook] Section 11 leaves us with no convenience exit across a five-year committed term, so we have added Section 11.4 letting Corio, as customer, terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice with a pro rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirming Commerce One has no convenience right during the initial or renewal terms. We can accept 60-90 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: 11.4 Customer Termination for Convenience. Corio (as customer) may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, in which case Commerce One shall refund pro rata any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial five (5) year term or any renewal term.
